newsitem.title: FINLAND: YIT-YHTYMA REPEATS SEES HIGHER 97 EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: YIT-YHTYMA REPEATS SEES HIGHER 97 EARNINGS.

text.p: Finnish construction group YIT-yhtyma said on Monday it expected net sales to rise to about 5.5 billion markka this year and earnings to exceed last year's 169 million markka profit before extraordinary items.
"The annual result before extraordinary items, appropriations and taxes is expected to exceed the previous year's 169 million markka profit," YIT said in a statement with its January-April results.
"YIT group net sales are expected to rise to about 5.5 billion markka in 1995," it said. Group 1996 net sales were 5.2 billion markka.
It reported first tertial profit before extras flat at 23 million markka and said the bulk of operating earnings in most main sectors would -- typically -- accumulate in the two later tertials.
YIT said the finance ministry's 10 percent growth forecast for house construction this year seemed cautious in the light of the latest building permits data.
Construction of offices, buiness buildings, public buildings, homes, as well as repairs were growing, particularly in the capital area and other growth centres, it said.
